payload.reason: The evidence provides specific improvements in performance metrics of the PAMPO model compared to alternatives, indicating a quantifiable enhancement in named entity recognition.

claims.text: PAMPO increases named entity recognition (NER) by at least 0.25 compared to other extractors.
The second phase of the PAMPO process increases a quality measure from 0.72 to 0.87, indicating significant improvement over alternatives.
PAMPO shows better results and a higher mean performance metric compared to three other extractors.
